3481.title: Chat drop geometry includes the secondary panel
3481.rootCauseOneLine: The single chat column lacks a pane target marker, so the drag resolver measures main including the secondary panel.
3481.proposedFix: Mark the inline main content with its pane context ID, preserving center replacement.
3481.caveats: Component harness and focused tests in two clean trusted checkouts; packaged desktop and persisted thread mutation not exercised.
